source.name: Cricsheet
source.note: Ball-by-ball facts from Cricsheet. Ball descriptions are original text, not broadcast commentary.

players.name: Sanju Samson
players.story: Keeper-batter with gorgeous timing; fans forever argue whether he gets enough chances.

players.name: Abhishek Sharma
players.story: Left-handed opener who swings from ball one; also chips in with left-arm spin.

players.name: Ishan Kishan
players.story: Pocket-rocket left-hander; when he gets going, bowlers stop enjoying the game.

players.name: Shreyas Iyer
players.story: Leading India in this match; loves charging the spinners and clearing long-on.

players.name: Tilak Varma
players.story: Calm young left-hander from Hyderabad, trusted to hold the middle order together.

players.name: Naman Dhir
players.story: Young finisher with a fearless swing, still making his name at international level.

players.name: Nitish Kumar Reddy
players.story: Seam-bowling all-rounder from Andhra who hits hard down the order.

players.name: Bhuvneshwar Kumar
players.story: Swing king with the new ball; the veteran India turns to when it's tight.

players.name: Prince Yadav
players.story: Young fast bowler, quick and skiddy, trying to make the spot his own.

players.name: Arshdeep Singh
players.story: Left-arm quick, death-overs specialist known for yorkers under pressure.

players.name: Varun Chakaravarthy
players.story: Mystery spinner and former architect; batters often cannot read which way it turns.

players.name: Tim Seifert
players.story: Keeper-opener who attacks from the first ball; loves pace on the ball.

players.name: Finn Allen
players.story: One of the cleanest strikers in world cricket; boom or bust at the top.

players.name: Daryl Mitchell
players.story: Big-match all-rounder who has hurt India in knockout games before.

players.name: Glenn Phillips
players.story: Freak athlete: flying catches, big sixes, and part-time spin.

players.name: Bevon Jacobs
players.story: Young hitter getting his early chances in the Black Caps middle order.

players.name: Michael Bracewell
players.story: Off-spinning all-rounder and a dangerous lower-order hitter.

players.name: Mitchell Santner
players.story: Crafty left-arm spinner and New Zealand white-ball captain.

players.name: Nathan Smith
players.story: Seam-bowling all-rounder who keeps taking wickets with honest pace.

players.name: Adam Milne
players.story: Genuine tearaway quick who can hit 150 km/h when fit.

players.name: Jacob Duffy
players.story: Tall swing bowler who earned his place grinding through domestic cricket.

players.name: Blair Tickner
players.story: Bustling seamer who bowls into the pitch and never stops running in.
